prompt.text:
Implement strict in-memory JSON parsing in package `solution`.

Export:

- `type Badge struct { Label string; Level string }` with JSON field names `label` and `level`
- `var ErrMalformedBadge error`
- `var ErrInvalidBadge error`
- `func ParseBadge(data []byte, allowedLevels []string) (Badge, error)`

The input must contain exactly one JSON object, followed only by whitespace. Reject empty input, malformed JSON, unknown fields, and trailing JSON values with an error wrapping `ErrMalformedBadge`. Duplicate fields use `encoding/json`'s normal last-value behavior.

After decoding, `Label` must be nonempty after trimming surrounding whitespace; store the trimmed label. `Level` must exactly equal an entry in `allowedLevels`, with case and whitespace significant. Otherwise return an error wrapping `ErrInvalidBadge`. Do not mutate either input argument. On every error, return the zero `Badge`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
